new-moon.name: New Moon
new-moon.summary: A quiet beginning, inviting space for intentions before anything needs to take shape.
new-moon.meaning: The New Moon marks the close of one lunar cycle and the beginning of another. It offers a pause in which possibility can exist without pressure for immediate answers.
focus: Making room for a new direction
reflection: What would I like to begin with care?
What can remain unwritten for a little longer?
practices: Choose a quiet moment without distraction

waxing-crescent.name: Waxing Crescent
waxing-crescent.summary: The first light returns, encouraging small steps towards what you have chosen.
waxing-crescent.meaning: The Waxing Crescent follows the darkness of the New Moon. It reflects the early stage of an idea, when commitment is built through modest and deliberate action.
waxing-crescent.energy: Hopeful, curious and gently gathering momentum.
focus: Protecting new ideas while they grow
reflection: What deserves a little more of my attention?
Which small action would make my intention real?
practices: Notice evidence of progress, however small

first-quarter.name: First Quarter
first-quarter.summary: Half light and half shadow bring a moment for choice, movement and honest adjustment.
first-quarter.meaning: The First Quarter Moon represents a point of tension and decision. Early intentions meet practical reality, revealing where resolve or a change of approach may be needed.
focus: Choosing what to continue or change
reflection: Where am I being asked to decide?
Is this obstacle a warning or an invitation to adapt?
practices: Break a difficult step into two smaller ones

waxing-gibbous.name: Waxing Gibbous
waxing-gibbous.summary: Growing light favours refinement, patience and attention to what is nearly ready.
waxing-gibbous.meaning: The Waxing Gibbous Moon is a period of development between action and culmination. It invites thoughtful improvement without mistaking perfection for progress.
reflection: What adjustment would strengthen it without overworking it?
practices: Finish one detail that has been lingering

full-moon.name: Full Moon
full-moon.summary: The cycle reaches full illumination, bringing feelings, patterns and results into clearer view.
full-moon.meaning: The Full Moon is traditionally associated with culmination and revelation. What has been developing may become easier to recognise, celebrate or release.
focus: Acknowledging what has come to light
reflection: What can I see clearly now?
What has reached a natural point of completion?
practices: Record what the cycle has shown you
Offer gratitude for one completed thing

waning-gibbous.name: Waning Gibbous
waning-gibbous.summary: After the peak, the light begins to soften and experience becomes something to share and understand.
waning-gibbous.meaning: The Waning Gibbous Moon follows culmination with integration. It is a time to gather meaning from what occurred and allow insight to become useful wisdom.
focus: Sharing what may help someone else
reflection: What have I learned that I did not know before?
What insight is worth carrying forward?

last-quarter.name: Last Quarter
last-quarter.summary: Another half-lit threshold asks what can be released, resolved or seen differently.
last-quarter.meaning: The Last Quarter Moon invites reassessment as the cycle turns towards completion. It can highlight habits, obligations or stories that no longer need to travel onward.
focus: Releasing what has served its purpose
reflection: What am I ready to stop carrying?
What would become possible if I let this go?
practices: Clear one physical or mental space
Complete an overdue conversation with care

waning-crescent.name: Waning Crescent
waning-crescent.summary: The final light of the cycle encourages rest, surrender and trust in the quiet between chapters.
waning-crescent.meaning: The Waning Crescent Moon is a closing phase. Rather than demanding another push, it offers time to restore energy and let the past cycle settle before renewal.
focus: Resting without needing to earn it
Leaving space for what comes next
reflection: What needs gentleness rather than another solution?
Where can I allow an ending to be enough?
practices: Spend a few minutes in deliberate stillness
